knowledge:
- key_parameters: controlGenes=Specifies group-specific genes (e.g., "Y" chromosome genes) to check for mis-annotation ;; labels=Vector of feature labels (e.g., chromosome names) to filter ;; featureName=The feature metadata column name to filter on ;; keepOnly=Logical indicating whether to keep only the specified labels or filter them out ;; groups=Phenotype variable to group and color density plots ;; normalized=Logical indicating whether the input matrix is already normalized and log-transformed
- alternatives: None mentioned. The package leverages existing Bioconductor tools and statistical techniques to streamline the workflow.
- when_to_use: Use when preprocessing large, heterogeneous, and sparse RNA-Seq datasets (such as GTEx) containing multiple tissues, groups, or conditions where tissue-specific expression patterns must be preserved during filtering and normalization.
- pitfalls: When plotting density after running `normalizeTissueAware`, the function assumes the normalized matrix is already log-transformed. Users must ensure their input data is formatted as an ExpressionSet with properly annotated phenoData and featureData.

workflows.name: rna_seq_preprocessing_and_normalization
workflows.intent: Preprocess, quality-control, filter, and normalize multi-tissue RNA-Seq expression data.
input: ExpressionSet object (containing gene count matrix, phenotype metadata, and feature metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Check for sample mis-annotation using checkMisAnnotation ;; 2. Identify sub-groups/tissues to merge using checkTissuesToMerge ;; 3. Filter lowly expressed genes using filterLowGenes ;; 4. Filter specific gene groups (e.g., sex chromosomes) using filterGenes ;; 5. Visualize raw expression density using plotDensity ;; 6. Normalize expression data in a tissue-aware manner using normalizeTissueAware ;; 7. Visualize normalized expression density using plotDensity ;; 8. Perform dimensionality reduction and quality control visualization using plotCMDS and plotHeatmap
workflows.code:
library(yarn)
data(skin)
checkMisAnnotation(skin,"GENDER",controlGenes="Y",legendPosition="topleft")
checkTissuesToMerge(skin,"SMTS","SMTSD")
skin_filtered = filterLowGenes(skin,"SMTSD")
dim(skin)
dim(skin_filtered)
tmp = filterGenes(skin,labels=c("X","Y","MT"),featureName = "chromosome_name")
tmp = filterGenes(skin,labels=c("X","Y","MT"),featureName = "chromosome_name",keepOnly=TRUE)
plotDensity(skin_filtered,"SMTSD",main=expression('log'[2]*' raw expression'))
skin_filtered = normalizeTissueAware(skin_filtered,"SMTSD")
plotDensity(skin_filtered,"SMTSD",normalized=TRUE,main="Normalized")
data(skin)
res = plotCMDS(skin,pch=21,bg=factor(pData(skin)$SMTSD))
filtData = filterLowGenes(skin,"SMTSD")
plotDensity(filtData,groups="SMTSD",legendPos="topleft")
library(RColorBrewer)
tissues = pData(skin)$SMTSD
heatmapColColors=brewer.pal(12,"Set3")[as.integer(factor(tissues))]
heatmapCols = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu"))(50)
plotHeatmap(skin,normalized=FALSE,log=TRUE,trace="none",n=10,
 col = heatmapCols,ColSideColors = heatmapColColors,cexRow = 0.25,cexCol = 0.25)
